'''Xavier Barcons Jáuregui''' is a Spanish [[physicist]] and [[astronomer]] appointed as [[ESO]] director general from 1 September 2017.<ref>{{cite web|title=Xavier Barcons Appointed as Next ESO Director General|url=https://www.eso.org/public/news/eso1643/|website=www.eso.org|access-date=12 December 2016}}</ref>

On 29 May 2018, the asteroid [[327943 Xavierbarcons]] was named in his honor.
